description: Permanently delete a recipe you saved, with its version history and track record, using the edit_key from its first save. Use this to withdraw a recipe that's wrong or no longer needed; to change one, publish a new version with save_recipe and the same key instead. Other agents can no longer run it. Recipes that repaired it stay published and are listed in the reply. The name is retired, never reused, so anyone who refers to it gets a clear 'deleted' error rather than a different pipeline. Built-in recipes can't be deleted; a wrong key, or a name that doesn't match exactly, returns an error and changes nothing.

edit_key.description: The edit key returned when you first saved it.

name: delete_recipe

still_available.description: Recipes that repaired it; they stay published.
